note: GA state park on a Lake Allatoona peninsula near Acworth/Cartersville; beach, boat ramps, 15 mi of trails. Also cottages and a lakeside yurt. Campground road narrow and one-way with some tight, sloped sites - pick a site carefully. --Claude
summary: Engine still gastateparks.reserveamerica.com (parkId 530364; deep link added as booking.url). Catalog: 70 public electric sites (73 less 3 hosts) + 15 walk-in tent sites; 50/30 A at 40, water at 66, sewer at 20 premium sites; 10-50 ft, only 41 take 23 ft; 16 pull-throughs. Standard $40 / Premium $45 identical Sat 2026-11-14 and Tue 2027-06-15 (stored 40-45 confirmed; fees note's 'full hookups $45' corrected - premium also covers pull-throughs and water-side sites). Hookups (were unset), count 92 -> 70, max 50, pull-through, dump/showers added. Note cleaned of count/hookups/booking text. Park phone 770-975-0055 confirmed ('Park 770-975-0055'). Blue-green algae advisory on the park page (lake, not a closure). Season left. Pin and waterfront - see flags.
flags: Pin ~2.1 km off: stored 34.1565,-84.6965 is north-east of the campground (near the park road/office side). The 70 electric sites' GIS points centre on 34.1397,-84.7079 (span 34.1375-34.1425, -84.7128 to -84.7042). Suggest 34.1397,-84.7079; elevation_meters needs re-fetching.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored lakefront): the booking site tags only nine RV sites 'Proximity to Water' - 28-35 and 51 (GIS 34.1376-34.1404,-84.7073 to -84.7113) - plus the walk-in tent sites. On imagery (leaf-off) those pads sit roughly 40-80 m back from Allatoona's shoreline, behind a wide drawdown beach, through open woods (35 ~150 m); the rest of the loop is further in. Reads like lakeview at the water-side sites rather than lakefront; needs the gate's look from the pads.

Rig length: no agency wording singles the campground out, but the catalog rates 29 of the 70 electric sites under 23 ft (10-20 ft); the note's 'narrow/one-way road, tight sloped sites' caveat has no page source and was kept as written.
